title: Downloads disappear
text: Albums downloaded for a flight disappear after the app refreshes.

title: Offline playback fails
text: Downloaded songs still show a network error in airplane mode.

title: 无法离线播放
text: 已经下载的歌在地铁里仍然提示需要联网。

title: Lyrics are late
text: Synced lyrics stay several seconds behind the vocals.

title: 歌词不同步
text: 歌词经常比歌曲慢几句，重新打开也没有恢复。

title: Wrong lyric version
text: The lyrics are for the studio recording while a live version is playing.

title: Collaborative edits vanish
text: Songs added by friends vanish from our shared playlist.

title: 共享歌单不同步
text: 朋友添加了歌曲，但我的共享歌单一直看不到修改。

title: Duplicate playlist edits
text: Concurrent collaborative edits create duplicate tracks.

title: Recommendations repeat
text: The discovery mix recommends the same artists every day.

title: 推荐越来越重复
text: 每日推荐连续一周都是相同歌手，没有新音乐。

title: Dislikes ignored
text: Disliked tracks keep returning in the recommendation feed.

title: Offline queue resets
text: My downloaded queue resets whenever the app restarts without a connection.

title: 下载内容会消失
text: 每次更新应用后之前下载的专辑都会从离线列表消失。

title: Cannot verify downloads
text: Half the tracks marked downloaded cannot play offline.

title: Missing lyrics
text: Popular songs that had lyrics last month now show lyrics unavailable.

title: 歌词滚动卡住
text: 进入副歌后歌词滚动会卡住，必须重新打开播放页。

title: No manual sync
text: There is no way to report visibly out-of-sync lyrics.

title: Cannot identify editor
text: Shared playlists do not show who removed a track.

title: 协作修改被覆盖
text: 两个人同时编辑歌单时其中一方的修改会被覆盖。

title: Invites stop working
text: New playlist collaboration invites expire immediately.

title: Wrong genres
text: Recommendations ignore the genres I follow and promote unrelated releases.

title: 不理解收听偏好
text: 我主要听爵士乐但推荐页一直推送无关的流行歌曲。

title: Discovery feels sponsored
text: The recommendation shelf repeats promotions instead of learning from my history.
